column1: # Hand-reviewed verdicts for the constant value disagreements
# One row per name whose pages print more than one number where a version
# branch (disjoint generation intervals) cannot explain the difference.
# resolved_value must be one the pages themselves print -- a review never
# invents a number -- and stays empty when the corpus alone cannot say.
# The generator (tools/gen-include-def.py) writes the resolved print under
# the conflict block and quotes this verdict; unresolved names stay listed
# The full case studies (including the two reference divergences
# MAX_PATH and HTTP_QUERY_MAX) are in docs/constant-value-review.md.

column4: one page prints one name twice: the WZC_CONTEXT tmTf member sentence prints 'TMMS_DEFAULT_TF (0x0000ea60)' and the tmTd member sentence prints 'TMMS_DEFAULT_TF (0x00001388)' where the member name shows a td default was meant (the page lists tmTr/tmTc/tmTp/tmTf/tmTd and prints TMMS_DEFAULT_TR/TC/TP/TF beside them; no TMMS_DEFAULT_TD exists). 0x0000ea60 is the tmTf default on both the CE 5.0 and CE 6.0 copies; the page itself states 'Default values are defined in Wzcsapi.h'.

the CE 6.0 page prints the name twice in one enum list: in alphabetical order as 'RTCEF_GROUP = 0x00002000' and again, out of order directly after 'RTCEF_INVITE = 0x02000000', as 'RTCEF_GROUP = 0x02000000' (the same number RTCEF_INVITE carries). The CE 4.x and CE 5.0 pages print only 0x00002000, four rows to one.
